review:
The latest Buffalo King, with prairie animals on Megaways reels. Mesa wilds are the main base-game feature, each carrying a 1x to 5x multiplier.

Four or more scatters give 10 to 20 free spins, and every time a wild is part of a win, all wild multipliers go up by 1x for the rest of the round – so the bonus gets stronger the longer it runs. Three scatters retrigger five to 20 more. 96.02% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
